evaluated_segments.title: AI-Assisted Power Developers (Cursor, Claude Code, Cline, Antigravity)
evaluated_segments.pain: Exponential context window inflation during multi-turn loops. Logs, test traces, and redundant tool outputs fill 100k+ tokens, costing $0.10-$0.30 per turn and causing reasoning degradation (Lost-in-the-middle).
evaluated_segments.urgency: HIGH (Daily cash drain and productivity drop)
current_alternatives: Manual session restart / wiping context (destroys continuity)
RTK (Rust Token Killer) - requires Rust toolchain / CLI proxy setup
Anthropic Prompt Caching (mitigates cost, but does not prevent reasoning degradation)
evaluated_segments.why_eur_5: €5.00 is an impulse purchase threshold for working developers. It is less than the cost of 2 days of wasted API tokens.
evaluated_segments.trust_requirement: CRITICAL: Must be 100% offline, inspectable, zero external network calls, zero npm supply chain risks.
evaluated_segments.purchase_friction: LOWEST if delivery is single inspectable JS script via Gumroad with zero dependencies.

evaluated_segments.title: Freelancers & Boutique Agency Developers Billing Against Own API Keys
evaluated_segments.pain: Client projects running agentic coding workflows consume personal OpenAI/Anthropic API budgets directly out of project profit margins.
current_alternatives: Billing clients directly or cutting prompt frequency
evaluated_segments.why_eur_5: Instant ROI on the very first client session.
evaluated_segments.trust_requirement: HIGH: Privacy compliance for client codebase.

evaluated_segments.title: Local LLM / r/LocalLLaMA Developers
evaluated_segments.pain: Context bloat exceeds local GPU VRAM (8GB/16GB VRAM), causing token generation to drop from 40 tok/s to 3 tok/s or OOM crashes.
current_alternatives: GGUF quantization, strict n_ctx limits, open source python scripts
evaluated_segments.willingness_to_pay: LOW to MODERATE (Strong cultural preference for open-source software)
evaluated_segments.why_eur_5: Will pay only if tool is drastically simpler and faster than compiling python/rust packages.

evaluated_segments.title: Enterprise Software Engineers
evaluated_segments.pain: Context bloat across large monorepo agent sessions.
evaluated_segments.why_eur_5: Corporate procurement barrier makes purchasing a €5 Gumroad product on personal expense report difficult.

synthesis.rationale: Power developers running Claude Code / Cursor have personal financial agency, acute daily token cost pain, and €5 is below their deliberation threshold.
